sample_data_caveats: Both selected issuer cohorts and the entire evaluation period were seen before this question; no pristine OOS or independent cohort replication.

Current-vintage FINRA/source prices, reconstructed publication dates where official dates are absent, sparse asynchronous SEC same-class counts and conditional split/class bridges do not establish historical first-seen PIT or free float.

N is a published position balance, not daily short-sale flow. The same-S DTC identity cancels S; this test adds raw logN beyond an identical denomination/price/liquidity/support/age host instead of claiming a new DTC denominator.

All models are re-estimated on the same strict mature original operating-label rows with train-only preprocessing. The contrast tests the trained numerator bundle, not isolated architecture causality or all FINRA mechanisms.
LOW_SIR is a simple source rank sharing learned HOST participation and unknown-source slots. It is not a completely model-free account.

The fixed numerator-destroyed control preserves recipient denominator, support, clock and split units. Its effective changed balances must be reported; a single destruction is not a permutation distribution.

Conditional connected fractional economic units, same-decision-session closing references, cash0 and separately funded 10/20bp scenarios are not actual whole-share bid/ask fills, borrow, taxes or broker certification.

Unpriced contingent rights are segregated and unspendable. Operating diagnostics are not point total wealth when identification is false. Terminal common-value bounds do not supply a daily right-value path.

Four recent250 primary contrasts share date blocks. Other costs/windows/simple ranks and the one accepted PEER correlation are dependent descriptives, not study-wide significance, an allocation blend or independent paper source.

Old normalized avoid-rule/denominator findings and accepted matched FINRA model losses41aa/dccdf remain counterevidence, as do BASE/AUG/ORIGINAL32 and PEER transfer failures. A negative result closes this recipe without refuting all shorting mechanisms.
